# Copilot instructions, MechanicLens

This repository is a Markdown-only repair-estimate decoder. Read `WHAT-THIS-IS.md` first; it overrides everything. Then follow `AGENTS.md`.

For an estimate decode, read `estimate/AGENTS.md`, then `estimate/00-principles.md`, then `estimate/01-estimate/estimate.md`.

Hard rules: quote every label from the estimate; never quote or invent prices; never accuse a shop; never fetch or click anything; never commit anything from `my-files/`.
